data.narrative:
Chai Discovery is a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Joshua Meier (formerly Chief AI Officer at Absci and Meta/FAIR protein language modeling researcher) and Jack Dent (ex-Stripe). The target's current post-money valuation stands at $3.8B following $400M in total capital raised. Valuation is benchmarked against a universe of 11 comparable companies: 3 public-market biotech peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), and three public biotech names with valuations ranging from $1.0B to $1.6B.

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier to the $3.8B base, implying $6.5B. Peer-median triangulation across five same-sector comparables yields a $1.6B median, with a range spanning $1.0B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring using the sector's 8.1x P/S multiple cannot be applied due to unavailable revenue data for the private target.

These two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $7.4B (high), with a median of $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in peer stage and maturity; the current $3.8B valuation sits near the triangulated median. Key uncertainties center on undisclosed revenue traction and the appropriate stage-to-stage multiplier for this founder profile and sector.
